summary: Tested Phase 2 (UI polish, splash, the 'Book a Car' rename, swap buttons, place icons) on the Expo web preview at 390x844. All requested flows passed. Splash: splash-logo is visible at launch and keeps its aspect ratio (box 320x109, ratio 2.93, source 2000x682, contain). Home: PlacePair and home-swap-button swap correctly, home-book-driver-card reads 'Book a Car', and Bengaluru->Chennai returns 2 results. /find: find-swap-button is a 36px circle with radius 18 and works; find-ride-button goes to /search with 2 results. /search: editing with search-from-field, search-to-field and search-submit-button works; search-summary reopens edit mode. Booked trip trip_adf496008b7d (TRV-1050621D, Confirmed), then cancelled it (Cancelled); seats are back to 3, checked via the API. /hire?service=rent: the header says 'Rent a Driver'. Picked Bengaluru->Mysuru and the taluk resolved to 'Mysuru Taluk'. hire-swap-button swaps the places and the taluk then re-identifies as 'Bengaluru North Taluk'. hire-find-button returns 'DRIVERS FOR MYSURU (0)', which is expected because no hire drivers are seeded. /hire?service=book: the header and the hire-service-tab-book chip both say 'Book a Car', and swap works. Driver mode (DriverHome): driver-choose-book shows 'Car with Driver / Provide your car with driving service (Book a Car)', and driver-trips also shows 'Book a Car'. Offer tab: offer-origin-field shows the radio-button icon and offer-dest-field shows the location pin. Grep finds 0 'Book a Driver' strings in app/, src/ and backend/server.py. svc.book_car exists in all 23 locales (hi = 'कार बुक करें'). No red screens.

ui_bugs.issue: The booking ID 'TRV-1050621D' wraps onto 2 lines at 390px width because the chat icon sits beside it. Use numberOfLines={1} or a smaller font.

issues: Gold text on white or beige is likely below WCAG AA 4.5:1. Examples: the 'Become a Travoo Driver' heading, the 'Open route in maps' outline button, 'Change destination taluk', the 'Offer'/'Verify' outline buttons, the 'Instant booking' badge, the 'Pay your driver directly' title, and the gold header icons on /hire. Use a darker gold for text or keep gold for fills only.
Unlike home and /find, there is no swap button between search-from-field and search-to-field, so the screens are inconsistent. This was not in scope, so it is optional.
The 'Demo data' badge in the header sits higher than the title and is cramped in the top-right corner.

action_items: Optional: darken gold text and icons that sit on light backgrounds to meet contrast.
Optional: stop the booking ID wrapping on the booking confirmation card.
Optional: add a SwapButton to /search edit mode for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: PlacePair swap is the correct, simple approach: onFrom(to); onTo(from). The hire useTaluk hooks re-identify both taluks after a swap.

SERVICE_LABEL is still a hardcoded English map, and hire/[id].tsx, hire/requests.tsx and the admin screens use it directly. In non-English languages those screens will show 'Book a Car' in English. Use useServiceLabel() for consistent i18n.
Many driver and admin strings that mention 'Book a Car' are hardcoded English rather than t() keys. This was already true and is not a regression.
seed_data_creation: Booked the seeded trip trip_adf496008b7d as passenger (TRV-1050621D) and cancelled it in the UI; seats are back to 3. driver@travoo.in was in passenger mode (account_type=passenger). I temporarily set account_type=driver via PUT /api/me to test DriverHome, then restored it to passenger. No other data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: driver@travoo.in has account_type=passenger by default. To see DriverHome, PUT /api/me {account_type:'driver'} and restore it afterwards. Driver is not registered as a local driver, so /hire/driver redirects to registration step 1. Location picker: click the field, fill location-search-input, then click the first [data-testid^=location-option-]. The browser tool rewrites screenshot paths, so avoid f-string paths. A Metro restart during a run causes font 502s and serif fallback, which is transient.
